summary: Situated in this always popular and sought after development to the fringe of Penrith, easily accessible to the town centre, a modern, semi-detached, 3 bedroom family home, found in well maintained and presented order with a landscaped enclosed garden to rear and ample parking to the front.
description:
Built in 2019 by renowned local housebuilders Story Homes, and benefitting from the remainder of the NHBC guarantee, this appealing modern home presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-maintained, low-maintenance family property in a highly desirable residential development. Ideally positioned for easy access to Penrith Golf Course, The Beacon and the town centre, the property combines contemporary living with excellent everyday convenience.

The property has generous parking to the front, while the well-planned accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway with useful under-stairs cloak cupboard and downstairs WC. The spacious living room is positioned to the front and features an attractive wood-burning stove, while to the rear is the impressive dining kitchen, with bi-fold doors to the garden and fitted with a range of AEG appliances including a dishwasher, hob, double electric oven, fridge freezer and washing machine.

To the first floor are three bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from built-in wardrobes and a stylish en-suite shower room. There is also a separate modern family bathroom serving the remaining bedrooms.

Externally, the property enjoys block-paved parking for two vehicles to the side, together with an enclosed and landscaped rear garden. The garden is principally laid to lawn and incorporates an extended patio, providing an excellent space for outdoor dining and entertaining.

Properties within this sought-after development are always in demand, and an internal inspection is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, presentation and location on offer.

Directions From the town centre head north on Scotland Road turning right onto Salkeld Road. At the roundabout turn left towards Lazonby. Centurion Rise is on the left hand side after 200 metres.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • There is a development service charge circa £142.62 PA.
